name: Sure independence screening
model_likelihood: Sparse random-design linear regression y = X beta + epsilon
inference_algorithm: Compute X^T y and retain the largest absolute marginal scores
estimand: Candidate predictor set M_gamma of size floor(gamma n)
data_input: Individual-level centered X and y with unit sample-standard-deviation predictors
tunable_settings: Retained size d or fraction gamma

name: Iterative sure independence screening
model_likelihood: Same linear regression model as SIS
inference_algorithm: Repeated SIS-based selection and joint fitting, followed by screening of remaining variables against residuals
estimand: Union of selected candidate subsets with size below n, followed by final selection
data_input: Same individual-level predictor matrix and response as SIS
tunable_settings: Screening size at each step; SCAD or Lasso selector and its penalty; number of iterations; final model selector
